blocks.reason: test_masking_regression_1795 reads the tb.fits data file and fails on an AstropyUserWarning ('Unexpected extra padding at the end of the file') raised as an error; the gold patch only changes is_fits() for paths that do not end in a FITS extension, which does not apply to tb.fits, and the test patch does not edit this test.

test_update_comment fails on an 'Unexpected extra padding' AstropyUserWarning and test_fitsheader_script/test_fitsheader_table_feature fail on a 'non-ASCII characters are present in the FITS file header' AstropyUserWarning raised as errors; the gold patch only changes _format_float() for float card values, and the test patch does not edit these tests.

test_update_comment fails on an 'Unexpected extra padding' AstropyUserWarning and test_fitsheader_script/test_fitsheader_table_feature fail on a 'non-ASCII characters are present in the FITS file header' AstropyUserWarning raised as errors; the gold patch only changes the string/comment regex and doubled-quote handling in Card._split(), and the test patch does not edit these tests.

The PostgreSqlDbshellCommandTestCase tests mock subprocess.call/check_call and assert a temporary .pgpass file's contents; the gold patch switches runshell_db to subprocess.run with PGPASSWORD in the environment, so the unmocked call runs psql, and the test patch rewrites the tests to mock subprocess.run and expect the password (removing test_escape_characters).

DurationParseTests.test_negative expects '-15:30' and '-1:15:30' to parse with only the leading unit negative; the gold patch applies a single leading sign to the whole duration, and the test patch changes those expected timedeltas to fully negative values.

The failing tests (admin_docs, auth help text, forms, urlize, html escape, debug views, etc.) assert HTML escaping of a single quote as '''; the gold patch makes escape() use html.escape(), which emits ''', and the test patch changes those expectations to '''.

test_serialize_enums and test_serialize_class_based_validators expect enums serialized by value (TextEnum('a-value'), re.RegexFlag(16)); the gold patch serializes enums by name (TextEnum['A'], re.RegexFlag['DOTALL']), and the test patch edits both tests to the new form.

test_deconstruct_class_arguments defines DeconstructibleInstances inside the test method and expects it serialized as migrations.test_writer.DeconstructibleInstances; the gold patch serializes types by __qualname__, producing the <locals> path, and the test patch moves the class to module level.

test_missing_parent_link expects ImproperlyConfigured for a OneToOneField to the parent without parent_link=True, and test_render's state model lacks parent_link=True; the gold patch removes that error and only treats parent_link fields as parent links, and the test patch removes test_missing_parent_link and adds parent_link=True in test_render.

test_middleware_headers asserts the response headers of a default project without Referrer-Policy; the gold patch sets SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY to 'same-origin' by default, and the test patch adds 'Referrer-Policy: same-origin' to the expected headers.

test_execute_sql_flush_statements and test_sequence_name_length_limits_flush call execute_sql_flush(connection.alias, sql_list); the gold patch drops the using argument from the signature, and the test patch changes both calls to execute_sql_flush(sql_list).

test_session_delete_on_end and test_session_delete_on_end_with_custom_domain_and_path expect the deleted session cookie header without SameSite; the gold patch makes delete_cookie() pass samesite, adding '; SameSite=Lax', and the test patch adds SameSite to both expected headers.

test_check_sqlite_version expects the message 'SQLite 3.8.3 or later is required (found 3.8.2).'; the gold patch raises the minimum to 3.9.0 and changes the message, and the test patch updates the test to the 3.9.0 message.

test_deconstruct and test_deconstruct_negated expect a single-child Q to deconstruct into kwargs with empty args; the gold patch always deconstructs children into args, and the test patch changes both expectations to args=(('price__gt', F('discounted_price')),).
ResolverMatchTests.test_repr expects url_name and route printed without quotes; the gold patch formats them with %r, adding quotes, and the test patch changes the expected repr to the quoted form.

test_nopass and test_parameters expect settings_to_cmd_args_env to return an empty dict {} for env; the gold patch returns None when env is empty, and the test patch changes both expectations to None.

test_iterable_boundfield_select asserts a subwidget id_for_label of 'id_name_0' with auto_id=False; the gold patch returns the widget's attrs['id'] (None here), and the test patch changes the expectation to None.

test_non_form_errors_is_errorlist compares formset non-form errors to a plain ErrorList rendering ('errorlist'); the gold patch adds the 'nonform' CSS class, and the test patch changes the expected rendering to ErrorList(..., error_class='nonform').

ValueTests.test_deconstruct and test_deconstruct_output_field expect Value to deconstruct to 'django.db.models.expressions.Value'; the gold patch adds @deconstructible(path='django.db.models.Value'), and the test patch changes both expected paths to 'django.db.models.Value'.

test_foo_together_ordering, test_remove_field_and_foo_together and test_rename_field_and_foo_together expect four AlterUniqueTogether/AlterIndexTogether operations; the gold patch lets those operations reduce through each other so only two remain, and the test patch edits all three tests to the shorter operation lists.

test_abstract_inherited_fields asserts that an abstract model field and its inherited copies have different hashes; the gold patch makes Field.__hash__ depend only on creation_counter, and the test patch removes those hash assertions.

test_func_unique_constraint_lookups removes a constraint using a registered lookup after leaving the register_lookup context, which worked through the stale lookup cache; the gold patch clears the lookup cache on unregister so the lookup is no longer resolved, and the test patch moves the removal inside the context.

test_parameters expects psql arguments ['psql', 'dbname', '--help']; the gold patch puts extra parameters before the database name, and the test patch changes the expectation to ['psql', '--help', 'dbname'].

test_reset_index and test_reset_index_keep_attrs (DataArray and Dataset) and test_groupby_drops_nans assert the old reset_index results (kept 'x' coordinate, level indexes, identical objects); the gold patch reworks index/coordinate dropping so de-indexed coordinates are dropped or converted to base variables, and the test patch edits all of these tests.

test_csv_regex_error expects --bad-names-rgx=(foo{1,3}) to exit with an error because the comma splits the regex; the gold patch no longer splits on commas inside braces, so it parses, and the test patch changes the input to '(foo{1,}, foo{1,3}})' and the expected message.
test_create_new_paste asserts the pastebin request uses lexer=python3; the gold patch sends lexer=text, and the test patch changes the expected lexer to 'text'.

testing/test_conftest.py fails at collection because it imports unique_path from _pytest.pathlib; the gold patch removes unique_path in favour of resolved Path keys, and the test patch drops the import and rewrites the assertions that used it.

test_skip_package expects a pytestmark skip in a package __init__.py to skip both tests in the package; the gold patch removes the eager package-module marker collection, so only one is skipped, and the test patch deletes test_skip_package.

The test_show_fixtures_with_parameter* tests match setup-show output with bare parameter values (arg_same?spam?); the gold patch prints cached_param through saferepr, adding quotes, and the test patch changes the patterns to the quoted form.

test_transform_dense and test_transform_sparse expect transform() of a wrong-shaped X to raise ValueError, using a StepSelector fixture that validates with check_array and never sets n_features_in_; the gold patch removes the explicit shape check in _transform in favour of _validate_data's n_features_in_ check, so an IndexError is raised, and the test patch changes the StepSelector fixture to use _validate_data.

test_roc_curve_drop_intermediate expects the first roc_curve threshold to be max(y_score)+1 (2.0); the gold patch sets it to np.inf, and the test patch changes the expected thresholds to start with np.inf.

test_latex_code_role expects inline highlighted code as '\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{' + newline ... newline + '}}'; the gold patch adds '%' after the opening and before the closing to avoid spurious spaces, and the test patch updates that assertion. The other counted failure, test_latex_warnings, is a warnings-list mismatch the test patch does not touch and that the inline-code change does not explain.

test_autodoc_typehints_description_with_documented_init expects a 'Return type: None' field in the class description; the gold patch suppresses a None return type for classes, and the test patch removes those lines from the expected output.
test_unparse[(1, 2, 3)-1, 2, 3] expects a tuple to unparse without parentheses; the gold patch wraps non-empty tuples in parentheses, and the test patch changes the expected output to '(1, 2, 3)'.

test_pyproperty expects the property type annotation as a single text node ': str'; the gold patch parses the :type: option into ': ' plus a pending_xref, and the test patch changes the expected node structure accordingly.

test_pymethod_options expects the index entry 'meth5() (Class property)' for a :property: method; the gold patch drops the parentheses, and the test patch changes the expectation to 'meth5 (Class property)'.

test_args expects Permutation([[1], [1, 2]]) to raise ValueError for repeated elements in cycles; the gold patch allows non-disjoint cycles, and the test patch removes that raises() and adds an assertion for composed cycles.

test_python_relational expects python(Eq(x, y)) to be 'e = Eq(x, y)' without Symbol declarations; the gold patch makes StrPrinter print sub-expressions through self._print, so the symbols are declared, and the test patch changes the expected strings to include the Symbol lines.

test_ndim_array_initiation asserts len() of a rank-0 array is 0 and indexing [0] raises; the gold patch sets the loop size of a rank-0 array to 1, and the test patch changes the expectations to len 1 and rank_zero_array[0] == x.

test_Min and test_Max expect Min() and Max() with no arguments to raise ValueError; the gold patch removes that error so they return their identities, and the test patch changes the tests to assert Min() == oo and Max() == -oo.

test_infinity and test_neg_infinity expect oo.is_integer (and related) to be None, and test_minmax_assumptions uses a real non-rational symbol; the gold patch makes rational/algebraic/irrational imply finite so these become False, and the test patch edits all three tests.

test_subs_CondSet expects ConditionSet(n, n < x, Interval(-oo, 0)).subs(x, p) to be EmptySet; the gold patch stops evaluating the condition against the base set on subs, returning Interval(-oo, 0), and the test patch changes that expectation.

test_Eq asserts Eq(ProductSet({1}, {2}), Interval(1, 2)) stays unevaluated; the gold patch makes set equality fall back to mutual subset checks, giving S.false, and the test patch changes the assertion to 'is S.false'.

test_imageset_intersect_real expects imageset(n + (n-1)(n+1)I, Integers) ∩ Reals to be Integers minus {-1, 1}; the gold patch intersects with the solutions of the imaginary part, giving FiniteSet(-1, 1), and the test patch changes the expectation.

test_create, test_create_f, test_commutation, test_NO and test_Tensors expect LaTeX for creation operators and tensors without enclosing braces; the gold patch wraps them in {...}, and the test patch updates all five expected strings.
test_create_expand_pow_optimization expects cc(-x**4) == '-x*x*x*x'; the gold patch parenthesizes the operand of a unary minus, giving '-(x*x*x*x)', and the test patch changes these expectations.

Both test_hermite_normal tests expect the HNF of [[2, 7], [0, 0], [0, 0]] to be an empty 3x0 matrix; the gold patch processes all rows until n pivots are found, giving [[1], [0], [0]], and the test patch changes both expectations.

test_as_set expects Contains(x, FiniteSet(y)).as_set() to raise NotImplementedError; the gold patch returns the set argument, and the test patch replaces the raises() with assertions that as_set() returns the set.
